title: Linden Maywalk
description: A gently ambling waltz begins with a descending answer rather than a grand entrance. In the centre, the left hand divides into a held bass and a moving tenor, while the melody opens above them. The later falling quotation restores a simpler texture, ending on the warm side of an unresolved ninth.
technical_note: Balance the central three voices separately. Hold the bass with the little finger while the tenor moves without reattacking the held key; all complete hand spans remain within an octave. Keep the return light after the fuller middle.

performance.note: Deliberate dance pulse, shaped phrases and terraced dynamics; no random timing.

composition_time_source: Recorded when the first score was saved.

audio_reverb.description: Subtle warm room; preserve the clarity of moving voices.
